# MyTattoo

> Deposit-secured booking for independent tattoo artists — turn your Instagram bio link into a reference-attached booking that's confirmed by a deposit.

MyTattoo (MyTattoo.Software) helps independent tattoo artists turn their Instagram bio link into a branded booking page. Clients send their idea, placement, size and reference images with no account needed; the artist reviews the request and offers a time and a deposit; the appointment lands on the calendar only once the deposit has been paid through Stripe. MyTattoo is a trading name of JOHN POWELL LTD, a company registered in England and Wales. The app runs at https://app.mytattoo.software and sign-up is self-serve (a booking page is switched on after a quick check).

## Key facts

- Who it's for: one independent tattoo artist managing their own books. It does not offer multi-artist or shared studio calendars yet.
- Price: free until 31 March 2027 — no subscription, no platform fee, no commission on deposits. Stripe's standard card processing fee applies. Paid plans will follow with 90 days' notice.
- Payments: deposits are paid by card through Stripe into the artist's own Stripe account. The artist sets a fixed or percentage deposit. The remaining balance can be collected on the day by card link, QR code or recorded as cash. Nothing is refunded automatically; the artist decides.
- Scheduling: the artist sets weekly hours and offers specific times; the client picks one of the offered times and pays the deposit to secure it. Clients can ask for a different time or cancel online. There is no Google Calendar sync; clients can add their appointment to their own calendar.
- Notifications: emails at each step (new request, offer, deposit paid) and an email reminder to the client 48 hours before the appointment. No SMS/text reminders.
- Also included: digital consent forms signed on the client's phone, a client book with private notes and medical flags, a waitlist, a walk-in queue, an earnings list with CSV export by UK tax year, and reports including no-show and cancellation rates.
- Not included: Instagram DM integration, marketplace/discovery listing, multi-artist studio management.
